mapper.sql: id, user_id, provider, status, provider_account_email, provider_account_id, granted_scopes, credential_ref, credential_generation, access_token_expires_at, refresh_lease_owner, refresh_lease_until, disconnecting_at, disconnect_attempt_at, capture_reconcile_required, capture_reconcile_after_workspace_id, capture_reconcile_lease_owner, capture_reconcile_lease_until, capture_reconcile_next_attempt_at, capture_reconcile_failures, error_code, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM provider_connection WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider}
SELECT FROM provider_connection WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM provider_connection WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE

SELECT FROM provider_connection WHERE status IN ('revoking', 'disconnecting', 'purge_failed') AND ( capture_reconcile_lease_until IS NULL OR capture_reconcile_lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) AND ( capture_reconcile_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR capture_reconcile_next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(disconnect_attempt_at, disconnecting_at), id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM provider_connection WHERE capture_reconcile_required = TRUE AND status NOT IN ('disconnecting', 'purge_failed') AND ( capture_reconcile_lease_until IS NULL OR capture_reconcile_lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) AND ( capture_reconcile_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR capture_reconcile_next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ORDER BY capture_reconcile_next_attempt_at, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_connection SET status = #{status}, provider_account_email = #{providerAccountEmail}, provider_account_id = #{providerAccountId}, granted_scopes = #{grantedScopes}, credential_ref = #{credentialRef}, credential_generation = #{credentialGeneration}, access_token_expires_at = #{accessTokenExpiresAt}, refresh_lease_owner = #{refreshLeaseOwner}, refresh_lease_until = #{refreshLeaseUntil}, disconnecting_at = #{disconnectingAt}, disconnect_attempt_at = #{disconnectAttemptAt}, capture_reconcile_required = #{captureReconcileRequired}, capture_reconcile_after_workspace_id = #{captureReconcileAfterWorkspaceId}, capture_reconcile_lease_owner = #{captureReconcileLeaseOwner}, capture_reconcile_lease_until = #{captureReconcileLeaseUntil}, capture_reconcile_next_attempt_at = #{captureReconcileNextAttemptAt}, capture_reconcile_failures = #{captureReconcileFailures}, error_code = #{errorCode} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider}

UPDATE provider_connection SET status = 'revoking', credential_generation = credential_generation + 1, disconnecting_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), disconnect_attempt_at = NULL, capture_reconcile_required = TRUE, capture_reconcile_after_workspace_id = 0, capture_reconcile_lease_owner = NULL, capture_reconcile_lease_until = NULL, capture_reconcile_next_attempt_at = NULL, capture_reconcile_failures = 0, refresh_lease_owner = NULL, refresh_lease_until = NULL, error_code = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider} AND status IN ('connected', 'paused', 'error', 'revoked')

UPDATE provider_connection SET status = 'disconnected', provider_account_email = NULL, granted_scopes = NULL, credential_ref = NULL, access_token_expires_at = NULL, refresh_lease_owner = NULL, refresh_lease_until = NULL, disconnect_attempt_at = NULL, error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND credential_generation = #{generation} AND status = 'revoking'

UPDATE provider_connection SET status = 'disconnecting', credential_generation = credential_generation + 1, disconnecting_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), disconnect_attempt_at = NULL, capture_reconcile_required = TRUE, capture_reconcile_after_workspace_id = 0, capture_reconcile_lease_owner = NULL, capture_reconcile_lease_until = NULL, capture_reconcile_next_attempt_at = NULL, capture_reconcile_failures = 0, refresh_lease_owner = NULL, refresh_lease_until = NULL, error_code = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider} AND status IN ( 'connected', 'paused', 'error', 'revoked', 'revoking', 'disconnected', 'purge_failed' )

UPDATE provider_connection SET capture_reconcile_required = NOT #{complete}, capture_reconcile_after_workspace_id = CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN 0 ELSE #{afterWorkspaceId} END, capture_reconcile_lease_owner = NULL, capture_reconcile_lease_until = NULL, capture_reconcile_next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN #{complete} THEN NULL ELSE DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 1 SECOND) END, capture_reconcile_failures = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND credential_generation = #{generation} AND capture_reconcile_required = TRUE AND capture_reconcile_lease_owner = #{owner}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM provider_connection WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider}
